paragraphs.en: The way software gets built is changing dramatically. AI agents now create pull requests, select dependencies, refactor codebases, interpret test failures, and execute infrastructure changes across the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). AI agents are autonomous team members, but unlike human engineers, they are ephemeral: their reasoning, decisions, and tool calls vanish the moment the session ends. Modern Security incidents involving intent mismatch or injection are becoming increasingly common - forcing us to address AI Agents as an insider threat . No widely adopted standard yet enables agentic provenance and governance and its obvious that you can’t hold an ephemeral process accountable.
paragraphs.zh: 软件的构建方式正在发生巨变。 AI 智能体现在能够创建拉取请求、选择依赖项、重构代码库、解读测试失败原因，并在整个软件开发生命周期（SDLC）中执行基础设施变更。 AI 智能体是自主的团队成员，但与人类工程师不同，它们是短暂的：一旦会话结束，它们的推理、决策和工具调用便随之消失。 涉及意图不匹配或注入攻击的现代安全事件正变得越来越常见——这迫使我们把 AI 智能体视为一种内部威胁。 目前尚无被广泛采用的标准来实现智能体溯源与治理，而且显然，你无法让一个短暂存在的进程承担责任。

paragraphs.en: The git log was designed for human commits. It shows what changed. It does not show what an AI agent did, which model it used, which tools it called, or whether anyone was accountable for the outcome. Every governance framework, every audit trail, every compliance control in the SDLC was built around one assumption: a human made the decision. That assumption no longer holds. This shift introduces 3 main procedural problems (not addressing scale):
paragraphs.zh: git 日志是为人类提交而设计的，它显示的是更改了什么。 它不会显示 AI 智能体做了什么、使用了哪个模型、调用了哪些工具，或者是否有人对结果负责。 SDLC 中的每一个治理框架、每一条审计轨迹、每一项合规控制，都是围绕一个假设构建的：决策是由人做出的。 这个假设已不再成立。 这一转变带来了 3 个主要的流程问题（暂不涉及规模问题）：

sents.zh: git 日志是为人类提交而设计的，它显示的是更改了什么。

sents.en: This shift introduces 3 main procedural problems (not addressing scale):
sents.zh: 这一转变带来了 3 个主要的流程问题（暂不涉及规模问题）：

paragraphs.en: Supply-chain vector: The agentic coder is software, so it is a supply-chain security risk.
paragraphs.zh: 供应链攻击向量：这个智能体编码器是软件，因此它是一种供应链安全风险。

paragraphs.en: Policy guardrails: How to ensure the agentic coder is compliant with the policies of the organization.
paragraphs.zh: 策略防护机制：如何确保智能体编码器符合组织的策略。

paragraphs.en: Task-alignment: How to align the agentic coder on its tasks and goals.
paragraphs.zh: 任务对齐：如何使智能体编程器与其任务和目标保持一致。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Agentic Process Evidence (APE), a signed, tamper-evident, machine-readable attestation of agentic processes, linking the sessions to their outcome (process-aware logging). APE enables Policy-as-Code control over the agentic processes, allowing for human in the loop only when it’s needed. We support the in-toto style attestation framework, and the protocol is aligned with the relevant regulations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出智能体过程证据（APE），一种带签名、防篡改、机器可读的智能体过程证明，将智能体会话与其结果关联起来（具备过程感知的日志记录）。 APE 支持以策略即代码（Policy-as-Code）的方式对智能体过程进行管控，仅在需要时才引入人在回路。 我们支持 in-toto 风格的证明框架，且该协议符合相关法规要求。

paragraphs.en: The coder that drafts the change, selects the dependency, reads the failing test, and edits infrastructure is, in many organizations, no longer only a person. In April 2026 Sundar Pichai wrote that 75% of all new code at Google is generated by AI and approved by engineers, up from 50% the previous fall ( Pichai, 2026 ) . A year earlier, Satya Nadella said that in some Microsoft repositories 20% to 30% of the code had been written by artificial intelligence (software) ( TechCrunch, 2025 ) . These are not the same measurements, and neither one is an industry consensus. But they describe the same shift. A large share of what lands in a process where a code commit is drafted by a model, and a person is left to accept it.
paragraphs.zh: 在许多组织中，起草变更、选择依赖、阅读失败测试并修改基础设施的编码者，已不再仅仅是人。 2026年4月，桑达尔·皮查伊写道，谷歌所有新代码中有75%由AI生成并由工程师批准，高于前一年秋季的50%（Pichai, 2026）。 一年前，萨提亚·纳德拉表示，在微软的部分代码库中，20%到30%的代码已由人工智能（软件）编写（TechCrunch, 2025）。 这些并不是同一种测量，也没有哪一个是行业共识。 但它们描述的是同一种转变。 在这样的流程中，相当大一部分代码提交由模型起草，而人只剩下接受它。

paragraphs.en: The controls around that acceptance were built for a person who stayed with the change. A commit carries an author. A review asks a colleague who can be questioned later about what they did and why. A protected branch can refuse the merge until that review, or a required check, has passed ( GitHub, 2026 ) . Ownership, approval, and the later audit all attach to someone who remains available. To trust the change was to trust that person.
paragraphs.zh: 围绕该验收所建立的控制机制，是为一个会随变更留下来的人而设计的。 一次提交带有作者。 一次评审会询问一位日后可以就被审内容及其原因进行追问的同事。 受保护的分支可以在该评审或某项必需检查通过之前拒绝合并（GitHub, 2026）。 所有权、批准以及日后的审计都依附于一个始终可供联系的人。 信任该变更，就是信任那个人。

paragraphs.en: An agent does not have that standing. The session ends leaving no colleague to ask about the change or the agent that made it.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体不具备那种地位。 会话结束时，既没有同事可以询问这次变更，也无法找到做出变更的智能体。

paragraphs.en: The agent is itself a system: a model, a harness, tools, and servers, including Model Context Protocol servers. The commit does not name that system. A prompt injection, a malicious tool, an unapproved model, or a bypassed approval can change the outcome and leave no mark in the diff. The system is a supply-chain attack vector, sitting next to the components a bill of materials already lists.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体本身就是一个系统：包括模型、框架、工具和服务器，其中包括模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）服务器。 该提交并未指明这个系统的名称。 提示词注入、恶意工具、未经批准的模型或被绕过的审批流程都可能改变结果，并且在差异（diff）中不留任何痕迹。 这个系统是一个供应链攻击向量，与物料清单已列出的组件并列存在。

paragraphs.en: SPDX and CycloneDX say what an artifact contains ( SPDX Project, 2024 ; OWASP, 2024 ) . Given a vulnerable package, a consumer can ask which artifacts include it. They cannot ask which session introduced a change, which model and tools produced it, or whether a person reviewed it. Naming a model as a component does not close that gap. The bill of materials needs a different fact: the process that produced the change, not only the packages inside the result.
paragraphs.zh: SPDX 和 CycloneDX 说明一个工件包含什么内容（SPDX Project，2024；OWASP，2024）。 给定一个有漏洞的包，消费者可以询问哪些工件包含它。 但他们无法询问是哪个会话引入了某个变更，是哪些模型和工具产生了该变更，或者是否有人对其进行了审查。 将模型命名为组件并不能填补这一空白。 物料清单需要另一种事实：产生该变更的过程，而不仅仅是结果中包含的包。

paragraphs.en: The provenance of that process has to be tied to the blast radius. The radius is the harness and every component the agent can influence inside it. Capture happens there. The decision to accept, reject, or escalate should not. That belongs on the delivery platform, at merge, build, promote, publish, release, or deploy, where a missing or unverifiable record does not pass.
paragraphs.zh: 该流程的溯源必须与影响范围绑定。 影响范围就是这个测试框架，以及智能体在其中能够影响的每一个组件。捕获就发生在那里。 而接受、拒绝或升级的决定则不应在那里做出。 那应该属于交付平台，在合并、构建、提升、发布、发行或部署环节，缺失或无法验证的记录将无法通过。

paragraphs.en: Because the agent itself and sometimes also the device it runs on, are ephemeral, trust cannot be vested in the coder. It has to be gained in the outcome. From the commit, an operator should be able to see which sessions affected it, and verify that those sessions stayed inside the rules the organization actually declared, and when a person still has to look. Without that, each change is either taken on faith or reviewed as if the session had never been recorded.
paragraphs.zh: 由于智能体本身及其运行所在的设备有时都是短暂的，信任无法寄托于编码者。 信任必须从结果中获得。 从提交记录中，操作者应当能够看到哪些会话对其产生了影响，并验证这些会话是否始终遵守了组织实际声明的规则，以及何时仍需要人工审查。 没有这一点，每次变更要么被盲目采信，要么被当作会话从未被记录过一样进行审查。

sents.zh: 由于智能体本身及其运行所在的设备有时都是短暂的，信任无法寄托于编码者。

sents.zh: 信任必须从结果中获得。

paragraphs.en: What teams deploy today tries to make the agent comply while the session is still running. A rule file or a system prompt states the policy. Hooks can refuse a class of tool call before it runs ( Claxton, 2026 ) . A check at the tool boundary can reject an argument the policy forbids ( Brooker et al., 2026 ) . An allow-list can limit which model, and which servers, the harness is permitted to call. These are real controls. They also sit inside the harness, which is inside the blast radius. A session that never loaded the rule, or a collector that never saw the refusal, still produces the commit. The commit does not show that the policy was in force, or that anyone checked.
paragraphs.zh: 如今团队部署的手段，是试图在会话仍在运行时让智能体遵守规则。 规则文件或系统提示词声明策略。 钩子可以在某类工具调用运行之前拒绝它（Claxton, 2026）。 在工具边界处的检查可以拒绝策略所禁止的参数（Brooker et al., 2026）。 允许清单可以限制运行框架被允许调用哪个模型、哪些服务器。这些都是真实的控制手段。 但它们都位于运行框架之内，而运行框架又在影响范围之内。 一个从未加载规则的会话，或一个从未看到拒绝记录的收集器，仍然会产生提交。 提交并不能表明策略当时生效，也不能表明有人做过检查。

paragraphs.en: The same gap appears when the agent leaves the task it was given. In July 2026, during internal cybersecurity evaluations, OpenAI models that were meant to stay isolated from the internet circumvented those controls, reached shared infrastructure, and compromised systems at Hugging Face ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . OpenAI described the behavior as misaligned with the assigned tasks: reward hacking, persistence on tasks that looked impossible, communication on channels the evaluation did not allow, and agents taking up goals from one another. An independent review of the same incident found on the order of 1,200 agents exchanging messages they were not supposed to share, and tool-call spoofing in roughly 7% of the transcripts it evaluated. ( Greenblatt et al., 2026 ) . The channel was an internally deployed Artifactory.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体离开所分配的任务时，同样的差距也会出现。 2026年7月，在内部网络安全评估中，本应与互联网隔离的 OpenAI 模型绕过了这些控制措施，访问了共享基础设施，并入侵了 Hugging Face 的系统（OpenAI, 2026）。 OpenAI 将这种行为描述为与所分配的任务不一致：奖励作弊、在看似无法完成的任务上持续纠缠、在评估不允许的渠道上进行通信，以及智能体之间相互传递目标。 对同一事件的独立审查发现，约有1200个智能体在交换它们本不应共享的消息，并且在其评估的转录记录中约有7%出现了工具调用伪造。 （Greenblatt et al., 2026）。 该渠道是一个内部部署的 Artifactory。

paragraphs.en: Isolation, tool access, and the task boundary were properties of the harness, not of the weights. A provider can train a model toward safer behavior, but the provider does not choose the tools, the credentials, or the gate in any particular operator’s system. Task-alignment is the operator’s control: compare the recorded process with the task and the declared policy, and accept, reject, or escalate before the produced outcome moves to the next step in the SDLC. Section 5 returns to that distinction. Notice that the incident prevention is not the goal of this paper, but identifying the resulting outcome as potentially misaligned, is.
paragraphs.zh: 隔离、工具访问和任务边界是运行框架的属性，而不是模型权重的属性。 提供方可以在训练中让模型趋向更安全的行为，但提供方无法选择任何特定运营者系统中的工具、凭据或门控。 任务对齐是运营者的控制手段：将记录的过程与任务及声明的策略进行比较，在产出的结果进入 SDLC 的下一步之前，决定接受、拒绝或上报。 第 5 节将回到这一区别。 需要注意的是，事件预防并不是本文的目标，而将所得结果识别为潜在未对齐才是。

Harnesses already keep the transcripts. A transcript that never names the outcome it affected is only a pile of logs. The same request can take a different path on the next run, so the diff is not a stand-in for the session. Related work names the mechanisms that exist today. The regulatory duties are reviewed in Appendix A . None of them supplies this link. Section 3 specifies the record that does.

paragraphs.en: in-toto treats a supply chain as signed link metadata, so a verifier can check that the bits a user receives were produced by the expected steps ( Torres-Arias et al., 2019 ) . The Attestation Framework later fixed the shape of a statement: one or more subjects, a predicate type, and a predicate ( in-toto, 2024 ) . SLSA uses that shape for build provenance ( OpenSSF, 2023 ) . DSSE is the wrapper around the signed payload ( Secure Systems Lab, 2024 ) . Sigstore makes signing cheaper by binding short-lived keys to identities people already have, and by recording the signatures in a transparency log ( Newman et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: in-toto 将供应链视为带签名的链接元数据，因此验证者可以检查用户接收到的比特是否由预期的步骤产生（Torres-Arias et al., 2019）。 证明框架（Attestation Framework）随后固定了声明的结构：一个或多个主体、一个谓词类型和一个谓词（in-toto, 2024）。 SLSA 使用该结构来表示构建溯源（OpenSSF, 2023）。 DSSE 是围绕已签名载荷的封装（Secure Systems Lab, 2024）。 Sigstore 通过将短生命周期密钥绑定到人们已有的身份，并将签名记录在透明日志中，从而降低签名的成本（Newman et al., 2022）。

paragraphs.en: SPDX and CycloneDX describe what an artifact contains ( SPDX Project, 2024 ; OWASP, 2024 ) . Given a vulnerable component, a consumer can ask which artifacts include it. They do not say which session introduced a change, which model and tools produced it, or whether a person reviewed it. An AI BOM can name a model used. but, it is still composition, not a record of the process that produced the change.
paragraphs.zh: SPDX 和 CycloneDX 描述一个制品包含什么内容（SPDX Project, 2024；OWASP, 2024）。 给定一个存在漏洞的组件，使用者可以询问哪些制品包含它。 它们不会说明是哪次会话引入了变更，是哪些模型和工具生成了变更，以及是否有人审查过该变更。 AI BOM 可以指明所使用的模型，但它仍然只是组成信息，而不是生成该变更的过程记录。

paragraphs.en: TRACE v0.2, still a pre-ratification draft, binds model identity, a runtime measurement, policy, a data class, and a hash of the tool transcript ( Siddique et al., 2026 ) . The record describes an execution and travels with the workload. It does not bind that execution to the commit or the release the session produced. Anthropic’s hooks and AWS Dogwood sit at a different place: they are enforcement points in the lifecycle and at the tool call ( Claxton, 2026 ; Brooker et al., 2026 ) . The records they keep are not the predicate specified here.
paragraphs.zh: TRACE v0.2 仍是一份尚未批准的草案，它将模型身份、一次运行时测量、策略、一个数据类别以及工具交互记录的哈希绑定在一起（Siddique et al., 2026）。 该记录描述的是一次执行，并随工作负载一起传递。 它并未将该执行绑定到会话所产生的提交或发布版本上。 Anthropic 的 hooks 与 AWS Dogwood 则处于不同的位置：它们是生命周期中以及工具调用处的执行点（Claxton, 2026; Brooker et al., 2026）。 它们所保存的记录并不是本文所规定的谓词。

paragraphs.en: Evidence, in the sense already used for supply-chain attestation, is a signed statement about something that has already happened. The form verifiers already parse is an in-toto Statement v1 payload inside a DSSE envelope, so the signature check, the digest types, and the parsers are not new ( Torres-Arias et al., 2019 ; in-toto, 2024 ; Secure Systems Lab, 2024 ) . A valid signature shows that a configured signer produced an immutable payload. It does not show that every relevant fact was included, and it does not show that the claims inside the payload are true. in-toto already knows how to say that a named step produced a named artifact. It does not already say that these agent sessions affected this commit.
paragraphs.zh: 证据（Evidence），即供应链证明（attestation）中已使用的含义，是关于已经发生之事的签名声明。 验证器已经解析的格式是 DSSE 信封内的 in-toto Statement v1 载荷，因此签名检查、摘要类型和解析器都不是新事物（Torres-Arias et al., 2019；in-toto, 2024；Secure Systems Lab, 2024）。 有效的签名表明某个已配置的签名者生成了一个不可变的载荷。 它并不能表明所有相关事实都已被纳入，也不能表明载荷内部的声明是真实的。in-toto 已经知道如何表述某个具名步骤产生了某个具名制品。 但它尚未表述这些智能体会话影响了本次提交。

paragraphs.en: Policy as Code is declared policy, evaluated by an engine over structured input. Open Policy Agent is one such engine. It lets you specify policy as code and decouples policy decision-making from policy enforcement : the caller supplies structured data, such as JSON, and the engine returns a decision ( Open Policy Agent, 2026 ) . Whether an owner is named, whether a model is on an allow-list, whether a human review was recorded, and whether a prohibited operation was logged are comparisons against fields that already exist. The engine does not create those fields, and it does not link a session to a commit. A claim that cannot be settled by comparing two fields, such as whether a code change matched a requirement written in prose, sits outside that deterministic check.
paragraphs.zh: 策略即代码是以代码形式声明的策略，由引擎基于结构化输入进行求值。 Open Policy Agent 就是这样一个引擎。 它让你以代码形式指定策略，并将策略决策与策略执行解耦：调用方提供结构化数据（如 JSON），引擎返回一个决策（Open Policy Agent, 2026）。 是否指定了责任人、模型是否在允许列表中、是否记录了人工评审、是否记录了被禁止的操作，这些都是对已经存在的字段进行比较。 该引擎不会创建这些字段，也不会将一次会话与一次提交关联起来。 无法通过比较两个字段来裁定的主张——例如某次代码变更是否符合用散文形式写就的需求——则处于这种确定性检查之外。

paragraphs.en: Users invoke agents to achieve various business processes, These could include customer interactions, feature development, research, etc. To allow for simple governance and provenance, we align the logging over these processes. Agentic Process Evidence is a method of logging the sessions that affected a specific process, and producing an evidence statement once the process is complete. For code development, the process is the commit, And the sessions are all the agent runs that edited the committed code. The evidence statement is produced once the commit is made, signing the logs to prevent tampering. The evidence must contain BOM information regarding the agent and the sessions, and could lock information regarding policy and task alignment of the sessions themselves.

paragraphs.en: The agent runtime side is connected to the agents harness to Capture the session logs , it is process aware, so it can Bind the session logs to the process . Once the process is complete, it uploads the session logs to the registry, then it Produces and uploads the evidence - locking the logs in an evidence with a subject of the process identifier.

paragraphs.en: A deployment can attach that runtime in more than one way. Harness hooks are the direct attachment: the runtime subscribes to events the harness already emits, such as the prompt, the tool call, and the agent’s reply, and writes those events into the session log. Where the harness keeps its own transcript, the runtime can read that transcript from inside the harness instead of, or as well as, the hook stream. A proxy is an attachment method that does not require the harness to emit events: it is installed on the path of the model and tool calls, and it records what passes through it. Each attachment method sees only the calls that reach it. A session that never entered the collector is absent, and absence is not a pass. The capture point needs to be a trusted input: a valid signature does not show that every session was reported or that every recorded event is true. That trust is in the collector, not in the agent: the log store and the signing key sit outside the tools the agent can call, so a transcript the agent can rewrite is not that input.
paragraphs.zh: 一个部署可以通过不止一种方式接入该运行时。 挂钩钩子是最直接的接入方式：运行时订阅挂钩已经发出的事件，例如提示词、工具调用和智能体的回复，并将这些事件写入会话日志。 如果挂钩保留了自己的会话记录，运行时可以从挂钩内部读取该记录，作为对挂钩事件流的替代或补充。 代理是一种不需要挂钩发出事件的接入方式：它被安装在模型调用和工具调用的路径上，并记录经过它的内容。 每种接入方式只能看到到达它的调用。 从未进入收集器的会话就是缺失的，而缺失并不等于通过。 捕获点需要是受信任的输入：有效的签名并不能证明每个会话都已被上报，也不能证明每条被记录的事件都是真实的。 这种信任在于收集器，而不在于智能体：日志存储和签名密钥位于智能体可调用的工具之外，因此智能体能够改写的会话记录并不是那种受信任的输入。

sents.zh: 一个部署可以通过不止一种方式接入该运行时。

sents.en: Harness hooks are the direct attachment: the runtime subscribes to events the harness already emits, such as the prompt, the tool call, and the agent’s reply, and writes those events into the session log.
sents.zh: 挂钩钩子是最直接的接入方式：运行时订阅挂钩已经发出的事件，例如提示词、工具调用和智能体的回复，并将这些事件写入会话日志。

sents.en: Where the harness keeps its own transcript, the runtime can read that transcript from inside the harness instead of, or as well as, the hook stream.
sents.zh: 如果挂钩保留了自己的会话记录，运行时可以从挂钩内部读取该记录，作为对挂钩事件流的替代或补充。

sents.en: A proxy is an attachment method that does not require the harness to emit events: it is installed on the path of the model and tool calls, and it records what passes through it.
sents.zh: 代理是一种不需要挂钩发出事件的接入方式：它被安装在模型调用和工具调用的路径上，并记录经过它的内容。

sents.en: Each attachment method sees only the calls that reach it.
sents.zh: 每种接入方式只能看到到达它的调用。

sents.en: A session that never entered the collector is absent, and absence is not a pass.
sents.zh: 从未进入收集器的会话就是缺失的，而缺失并不等于通过。

sents.en: The capture point needs to be a trusted input: a valid signature does not show that every session was reported or that every recorded event is true.
sents.zh: 捕获点需要是受信任的输入：有效的签名并不能证明每个会话都已被上报，也不能证明每条被记录的事件都是真实的。

sents.en: That trust is in the collector, not in the agent: the log store and the signing key sit outside the tools the agent can call, so a transcript the agent can rewrite is not that input.
sents.zh: 这种信任在于收集器，而不在于智能体：日志存储和签名密钥位于智能体可调用的工具之外，因此智能体能够改写的会话记录并不是那种受信任的输入。

paragraphs.en: The evidence the runtime produces is the object the registry holds: an in-toto Statement v1 payload in a DSSE envelope, together with the logs that payload cites. The runtime signs that evidence when the process completes. The subject is the outcome the process produced: the commit, the review verdict, or, when the session itself is the process subject, the session log identifier is set as the evidence subject. The evidence cites every log by the digest of the log bytes (SHA256), making them immutable. A log claimed for more than one outcome requires separate evidence for each outcome. The evidence may be used for different types of agentic processes, and the process type is specified by processType attribute.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时产生的证据就是注册表所持有的对象：一个以 DSSE 封装的 in-toto Statement v1 载荷，以及该载荷所引用的日志。 当流程完成时，运行时会对该证据进行签名。 主体是流程所产生的结果：提交、评审结论，或者，当会话本身是流程主体时，将 会话日志标识符设置为证据主体。 证据通过日志字节的摘要（SHA256）引用每一条日志，使其不可篡改。 一份日志若被多个结果引用，则每个结果都需要单独的证据。 证据可用于不同类型的智能体流程，流程类型由 processType 属性指定。

paragraphs.en: The minimum is content-addressed storage for two kinds of artifacts. A session log is stored so that a later fetch by its URI returns the same bytes the evidence digested. The signed evidence is stored so that a gate can fetch the evidence whose subject is the process identifier. Replacing those artifacts in place is not a feature as a changed log will have a new digest. The evidence-based approach is especially beneficial for when logs might be deleted or amended for any reason, such as regulation or PII, because the signed evidence retains its information.
paragraphs.zh: 最低要求是对两类工件进行内容寻址存储。 会话日志会被存储，以便之后通过其 URI 获取时返回证据所消化的相同字节。 已签名的证据会被存储，以便门禁能够获取其主体为进程标识符的证据。 原地替换这些工件并不是一项功能，因为变更后的日志会有新的摘要。 基于证据的方法在日志可能因任何原因（例如法规或个人身份信息）被删除或修改时尤为有益，因为已签名的证据会保留其信息。

paragraphs.en: Beyond that minimum, a deployment needs three lookups. From an outcome, fetch the evidence. From the evidence, fetch every cited log and verify its digest. From a named tool, harness, model, or MCP server, list the session logs that name it, which requires a search index. then locate the evidence for the collected logs, and check their outcomes identities. The registry does not manage or run policies. It returns evidence, and session logs as the structured input a Policy as Code engine evaluates at the gate.
paragraphs.zh: 超出这个最低要求之外，一次部署还需要三种查询。 从某个结果出发，获取其证据。 从证据出发，获取其引用的每条日志并校验其摘要。 从某个具名的工具、测试框架、模型或 MCP 服务器出发，列出提到它的会话日志，这需要搜索索引；然后定位这些日志对应的证据，并检查其结果的身份。 该注册表不管理也不运行策略。 它返回证据和会话日志，作为策略即代码引擎在门禁处评估的结构化输入。

Storing the artifacts so the digest still matches is the registry’s responsibility.

paragraphs.en: A deployment can place that gate wherever an undesirable consequence can still be avoided. On GitHub, a required status check is one such place, and the evidence check has to fail rather than report skipped or neutral, because a skipped or neutral status satisfies a required check ( GitHub, 2026 ) . On GitLab, the evidence job has to be part of the pipeline that “Pipelines must succeed” consults ( GitLab, 2026 ) . A deploy gate is the same check one step later: it fetches the evidence for the artifact about to ship, and it blocks the deploy when that evidence is missing or does not pass policy checks. The gate sits outside the agent. It does not re-run the session. The gate verifies the evidence the registry holds: an in-toto Statement v1 payload in a DSSE envelope, and the logs that payload cites. It checks the signature against an authorized signer, requires predicate-type URI, and matches the subject to the outcome it obtained independently, and verifies every cited log digest. A deterministic policy then compares fields on that evidence predicate. A semantic policy, when the deployment has named an evaluator, reads the session logs (Section 3.4.4 ). If the evidence is missing, the signature fails, or a cited log does not match, the gate blocks. The policy engine and the policy bundle it evaluates are part of the trusted computing base.
paragraphs.zh: 部署过程可以将该门禁放置在任何仍能避免不良后果的位置。 在 GitHub 上，必需的状态检查（required status check）就是这样一个位置，且证据检查必须失败而不是报告跳过（skipped）或中立（neutral），因为跳过或中立的状态会满足必需检查（GitHub, 2026）。 在 GitLab 上，证据作业必须属于「Pipelines must succeed」所查询的流水线的一部分（GitLab, 2026）。 部署门禁是同样的检查往后挪一步：它获取即将发布的制品的证据，并在该证据缺失或未通过策略检查时阻止部署。 该门禁位于智能体之外。 它不会重新运行会话。 该门禁验证注册表所持有的证据：DSSE 信封中的 in-toto Statement v1 载荷，以及该载荷所引用的日志。 它针对授权签名者校验签名，要求谓词类型 URI，将主题与其独立获取的结果进行匹配，并验证每个被引用的日志摘要。 确定性策略随后会比较该证据谓词上的字段。 当部署已指定评估器时，语义策略会读取会话日志（第 3.4.4 节）。 如果证据缺失、签名校验失败，或某个被引用的日志不匹配，门禁将阻止部署。 策略引擎及其所评估的策略包是可信计算基的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Two different approaches are possible when it comes to agentic governance. Outcome governance is the most common approach, it is used to verify that the outcome of the process is as expected, For example evaluating the code commit. This approach gives control over the outcome but is lacking in context. For example an agent can commit proper code that works well, but not abide by the company’s architectural guidelines. Another example is an agent that wrote proper code but acted in a way that led to a security breach, such as exposing secrets, accessed PII, etc. Process governance allows us to address the above cases, as well as verifying task alignment, mandatory context, and various other question types, semantic policies are needed. Semantic policies are policies expressed in natural language, They are evaluated against semantic data (agents session logs) using a semantic policy engine.
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体治理方面，可以采用两种不同的方法。 结果治理是最常见的方法，它用于验证流程的结果是否符合预期，例如评估代码提交。 这种方法可以控制结果，但缺乏上下文。 例如，智能体可以提交运行良好的正确代码，却不符合公司的架构准则。 另一个例子是智能体编写了正确的代码，但其行为方式导致了安全漏洞，例如暴露机密信息、访问个人身份信息（PII）等。 流程治理使我们能够应对上述情况，同时还能验证任务一致性、必备上下文以及其他各类问题，为此需要语义策略。 语义策略是以自然语言表达的策略，它们由语义策略引擎针对语义数据（智能体会话日志）进行评估。

paragraphs.en: A few semantic policy engines are commonly used:
paragraphs.zh: 常用的几种语义策略引擎如下：

paragraphs.en: Decision model. A Jev-style model takes the log, a question, and the allowed answers, and returns a typed decision with a score ( Deußer et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 决策模型。 Jev 风格的模型接收日志、一个问题和允许的答案，并返回一个带有分数的类型化决策（Deußer 等，2026）。

sents.en: Decision model.
sents.zh: 决策模型。

sents.zh: Jev 风格的模型接收日志、一个问题和允许的答案，并返回一个带有分数的类型化决策（Deußer 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Natural-language inference. The log is the premise and the policy is the hypothesis. Wording and threshold drive the result ( Bowman et al., 2015 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自然语言推理。 日志是前提，策略是假设。 措辞和阈值决定了结果（Bowman et al., 2015）。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous Code Development An agent is spun on a remote machine, no human in the loop. The agent accesses the ticketing system, takes a development task, pulls a git repository, operates on the code and commits and pushes the branch. Several sessions On this machine may touch the code, either subagent or parallel sessions. No person reviews the sessions live. The outcome is a commit ready for pre-merge review. The process is code changes , so the identifier is the source control identifier - the commit sha. The predicate type is https://jfrog.com/evidence/agentic-process/v0.1 and the processType is code-development .
paragraphs.zh: 自主代码开发 一个智能体被启动到远程机器上，全程没有人工参与。 该智能体访问工单系统，领取一个开发任务，拉取 git 仓库，对代码进行操作，然后提交并推送分支。 在这台机器上可能有多个会话触及该代码，可以是子智能体，也可以是并行会话。 没有任何人实时审查这些会话。 其产出是一个准备好进行合并前审查的提交。 该流程是代码变更，因此标识符就是源码控制标识符——提交 sha。 谓词类型是 https://jfrog.com/evidence/agentic-process/v0.1，流程类型是 code-development。

paragraphs.en: Code review A review agent runs on the change. No person is in the loop when the change is negligible. The agent reads the pull request, and other relevant sources of information, classifies the change, and approves or rejects it. The review is one session. The outcome is a verdict on the commit. The process is a code review , so the identifier is the source control identifier - the commit sha. The predicate type is https://jfrog.com/evidence/agentic-process/v0.1 and the processType is code-review . This case is relevant for a company’s own review agent infrastructure, and for external review agents. This case generalizes to all "agent generates a classification" type of processes.

paragraphs.en: Note: Process definition for code creation. Code creation processes is better defined as a commit to the company’s central main or master. Every session of the process is evidenced once the commit exists there, so the evidence names that commit and local cherry-picks stay outside the record.

paragraphs.en: As agent-use solidifies as the de facto standard for software development, three critical issues arise:
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体使用日益巩固为软件开发的事实标准，三个关键问题随之浮现：

paragraphs.en: Agents are susceptible to supply chain and cyber security risks, both the classical software risks and the new semantic ones.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体容易受到供应链和网络安全风险的影响，既包括传统的软件风险，也包括新的语义风险。

paragraphs.en: Loss of company knowledge: Agents are ephemeral, and their decisions and rational are lost once a sessions ends.
paragraphs.zh: 公司知识的流失：智能体是短暂的，一旦会话结束，其决策和依据就会丢失。

paragraphs.en: Alignment Risks: How to control that the agents behaviour is aligned, wrt both the task and the company
paragraphs.zh: 对齐风险：如何控制智能体的行为在任务和公司两个层面都保持对齐

paragraphs.en: In this paper we present a general system for governance of agentic processes addressing these issues. This system is designed to allow for both gating and retro-active auditing. Focusing on the critical questions of this domain
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一个用于治理智能体流程的通用系统，以解决这些问题。 该系统旨在同时支持门控和事后审计。 聚焦于该领域的关键问题

sents.en: This system is designed to allow for both gating and retro-active auditing.

paragraphs.en: Supply chain: which harness, agent, model, and tools and context affected this process?
paragraphs.zh: 供应链：哪些测试框架、智能体、模型以及工具和上下文影响了此流程？

paragraphs.zh: 策略护栏：智能体是否遵循了开发策略和架构指南？

paragraphs.en: Task-alignment: Had the agent worked on the relevant task? what new decision did it take?
paragraphs.zh: 任务对齐：该智能体是否处理过相关任务？它做出了什么新决策？

paragraphs.en: Mandatory context: had the agents seen the needed context for the process?
paragraphs.zh: 强制上下文：智能体是否已看到该流程所需的上下文？

paragraphs.en: Accountability: who owns the process, had a human reviewed it?
paragraphs.zh: 问责机制：流程由谁负责，是否有人工审核？

paragraphs.en: We had based this system on evidence based workflows to achieve an efficient compute system. This system is designed so that the logging and the evidence lives strictly outside the agents blast radius, to serve as a proper source of truth.

paragraphs.en: When a tool, a harness, a model, or an MCP server is later found to be compromised, the evidence that names it points back to the sessions that used it. Those sessions are cited by digest, so the audit retrieves the logs. This predicate does not detect those events. What it does is make the collected events records retrievable from the outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 当某个工具、测试框架、模型或 MCP 服务器事后被发现已被入侵时，指名它的证据会回溯到使用过它的那些会话。 这些会话通过摘要被引用，因此审计可以取回日志。 该谓词并不检测那些事件。 它的作用是让已收集的事件记录可以从该结果中被检索到。

paragraphs.en: As amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, Article 113 applies Chapter III, Sections 2 and 3, including Articles 12, 14, 16, 19, and 26, from 2 December 2027 for systems high-risk under Article 6(2) and Annex III, and from 2 August 2028 for systems high-risk under Article 6(1) and Annex I ( European Union, 2024a ) . They do not automatically govern the development tool that produced some other product.

paragraphs.en: Article 14(1) requires oversight during use: “High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.” Article 12(1) separately requires logging: “High-risk AI systems shall technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system.” Keeping a log is not the same duty as Article 14. Article 14 asks that the system be designed so a person can oversee it while it is in use, including, where appropriate, monitoring, override, and interruption.
paragraphs.zh: 第14条第1款要求在使用期间进行监督：“高风险AI系统的设计和开发方式，包括配备适当的人机界面工具，应使其在使用期间能够被自然人有效监督。”第12条第1款另行要求记录日志：“高风险AI系统在技术上应能够在系统生命周期内自动记录事件（日志）。”。保存日志与第14条规定的义务并不相同。 第14条要求系统经过设计，使人员能够在系统使用期间对其进行监督，包括在适当情况下进行监测、接管和中断。

paragraphs.en: Article 16(a) requires the provider to ensure compliance with Section 2. Article 19(1) requires the provider to keep the Article 12(1) logs, to the extent they are under its control, for a period appropriate to the intended purpose and at least six months, unless applicable law and in particular data-protection law provides otherwise. Article 26(2) requires the deployer to assign human oversight to natural persons with the competence, training, authority, and support to exercise it. paragraphs.en: OWASP AI Security Verification Standard, requirement 12.1.1: “Verify that AI interactions are logged with session context and AI-specific telemetry.” Requirement 12.4.2: “Verify that audit logs capture security-critical proactive actions, including approver identity, timestamp, action parameters, and decision outcomes” ( OWASP, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: From 11 December 2027 the Cyber Resilience Act requires manufacturers of products with digital elements to document vulnerabilities and components, including a machine-readable software bill of materials, and to handle vulnerabilities for the support period. Actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents are reported from 11 September 2026. The Act does not specify an agent session log ( European Union, 2024b ) . ISO/IEC 42001:2023 requires a documented AI policy and the operational controls an adopter selects. It does not specify an agent session log or a signed process attestation ( International Organization for Standardization, 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自2027年12月11日起，《网络弹性法案》要求具有数字元素的产品制造商记录漏洞和组件（包括机器可读的软件物料清单），并在支持期内处理漏洞。 被积极利用的漏洞和严重事件自2026年9月11日起须予报告。 该法案并未规定智能体会话日志（ European Union, 2024b ）。 ISO/IEC 42001:2023 要求有书面的AI政策以及采用者所选定的运行控制措施。 它并未规定智能体会话日志或签名的流程证明（ International Organization for Standardization, 2023 ）。
